mapper.select: select q.id as questionId, q.knowledge_point_id as knowledgePointId, k.name as knowledgePointName, q.type, q.stem, q.options, q.difficulty, eq.score as score, eq.sort as sort from exam_question eq join question q on q.id = eq.question_id left join knowledge_point k on k.id = q.knowledge_point_id where eq.exam_id = #{examId} order by eq.sort asc, eq.id asc
